reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "OperatorHub Packages Discontinued: We no longer publish OperatorHub packages for cert-manager", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: upgrade-blocked

consequence.statement: An environment that installs or updates cert-manager through OperatorHub cannot obtain cert-manager 1.17.0 (or any release after v1.16.5) from OperatorHub, because v1.16.5 is the last published release; the upgrade through that channel is unavailable.
consequence.remediation: Move the cert-manager installation off OperatorHub to another distribution method in order to upgrade beyond v1.16.5.

proposed.statement: cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages: v1.16.5 is the last release on OperatorHub (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io), and the cert-manager-olm repository is archived.
